description: This file defines a controller class for managing email subscriptions within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends a base Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for email subscription list rendering.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller class for handling email subscription views in the admin panel, extending the base Vue controller and initializing the email subscription list component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by creating and setting the email subscription list Vue component.
